summary: The 2D screening label is not_2d_applicable, and Studio did not run (simulation status: skipped; simulation_allowed=false; comparison_valid=false). The gate blocked the run because a custom experiment needs 1-128 blocks and a power_w object, and the extraction returned an empty floorplan and empty power map. The selected scenario (Experiment 1, 16-core hybrid 3D CMP with L2 SRAM / L3 eDRAM / L4 STT-RAM, PARSEC canneal, Fig. 7a, Table 4, Table 9) is a 3D stacked power-model validation. The paper reports only component power (cores, cache hierarchy, NoC) validated against GEM5/McPAT/Noxim/ORION/CACTI/NVSim, with CVX used for dark-silicon power budgeting. It reports no temperature, floorplan, package model or thermal solver, and Tmax = 80 C is only a design limit and leakage-model input. Had a run been attempted it would have been a custom 2D steady run with no transient trace and only an illustrative generated placement, not a reproduction. The scenario is neither a bundled EV6/GCC adaptation nor a pinned Ascend910/ATPlace case, so no source commit or pinned-size placement applies. No numerical comparison with the paper is possible because there is no Studio output and no paper temperature. The only paper numbers are power-model validation differences for hybrid canneal (cores 4.762%, cache hierarchy 14.151%, NoC 0%), which are not thermal quantities. The final verdict is therefore no thermal replication or comparison, and nothing here should be read as exact replication.
limitations: Studio was not run; no temperatures, artifacts or traces exist.
The paper reports no thermal observable, so there is no location, aggregation or steady/transient regime to match, and no numerical comparison is valid.
Mismatch: the paper models a 3D stack with TSVs, while Studio would use a 2D steady model that cannot represent vertical stacking or TSV coupling.
Mismatch: no floorplan coordinates or block dimensions are published; only a 3.5 mm2 per-core area (Table 4) and per-technology bank areas (Table 1), with no aspect ratios or placement.

Mismatch: per-block canneal power appears only as unlabeled bar heights in Fig. 7a and was not digitized; the 110 W Pmax is a budget, not measured power, and cannot be split across blocks without a published rule.
Mismatch: no package, heat sink, TIM, ambient or material parameters are given; Studio defaults would not be paper-derived.
Mismatch: the paper's CVX budgeting and core gating are not thermal controllers, and no power time series is published, so a transient comparison is impossible.

The paper models a 3D stacked CMP (core layer plus 3 layers each of L2/L3/L4 caches, with TSV links), not a 2D planar or interposer chiplet system. A 2D steady-state Studio model cannot represent the vertical stacking, TSVs or the thermal coupling in a core set.

No thermal solver, temperature map, or temperature observable exists in the paper. Only power is validated, and Tmax is a fixed constant in the leakage terms, so there is no thermal result to compare against.

No floorplan is published: no block x/y coordinates, widths or heights for caches, NoC or other blocks. Only the core area (3.5 mm2 each, Table 4) and cache bank areas (Table 1, per technology) are given, and these are not same-scenario placed dimensions.
Per-block power is not published numerically. The component powers for canneal appear only as bar-chart heights in Fig. 7a, and the total chip power cannot be split without a published rule.
No cooling or package model (heat sink, TIM, convection, ambient) is described; ambient/maximum temperature enters only as a scalar leakage coefficient.

The workload is a GEM5 trace-driven execution with activity-dependent power, but no power time series is published. The paper's optimizer and controller (CVX budgeting, dark-silicon core gating) are not thermal management methods and have no Studio equivalent.
There is no reliability analysis; the NVM write endurance discussion is qualitative only.

No complete paper-derived experiment (dimensions, power per block, thermal observable) exists, so the floorplan is returned empty. Any Studio run would be only an illustrative separate 2D placement, with generated coordinates kept distinct from paper facts.

If an illustrative run were built, it would use only dimensions and powers explicitly published: the core area of 3.5 mm2 per core (Table 4) and the Table 1 bank areas. It would use a single-row power trace, and its temperatures would not be compared numerically with the paper, which reports none.
Total chip power would not be split across blocks without a published rule. The Pmax of 110 W is a budget, not a measured canneal power.
Studio package and material assumptions (default silicon die, heat spreader, heat sink and ambient) are not given in the paper. They would be the bundled Studio defaults and are not paper-derived.
